text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I lost...
But I... I wanted to win so bad...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, H-E-double-hockey-sticks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Everyone's gonna be so disappointed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You did your best, Yukino! We're so
proud of
you!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Who cares if you lost? There's always
next time!
Just dust yourself off and
smile like always!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hey, the concert's gonna start soon! That's when the real show starts! Let's get ready.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: They don't care if I win?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Great job, Harp Alpha! What a race!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We're looking forward to the fall races!
I'm sure
you'll knock our socks off then
too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How come my fans aren't say'n that
kinda stuff?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What makes me and her so diff'rent?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin may not have won, but she
still did well. However, there's more than
just simple frustration on her face when
she returns to the
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urk...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I lost and nobody even seemed t'care!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's like they don't give a hoot 'bout my
rac'n
abilities...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw geez... Sorry for gett'n so down in
the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's 'cause I lost. If I won, maybe
they'd
understand.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted t'show everyone how cool I can
be when
I'm runn'n, but that didn't
happen...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Which just means I've gotta work harder
t'win the
Shuka Sho! That'll help me
steal everyone's
hearts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho is the final race of the
Triple Tiara tour. If Yukino Bijin is able
to win there, the
spectators should come
to appreciate her skill.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta run real spiffy-like! Then,
surely,
someth'n'll change...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Don't y'think?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
How about a word for your fans
watching at
home? In that cute accent of
yours, if you don't
mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bridging the gap between what she
wants and what the spectators want will
be no simple task.
But she's trying to
remain optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! Can I ask a favor?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do a race b'fore the Shuka Sho
t'make
sure I turn heads.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll help me hold on to this
strong
desire
t'win...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Any idea which one I should do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Senior-year runners can also enter the
Queen Stakes, which makes it a good
place to test her strength and solidify
her confidence before the
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's perfectly peachy t'me! I'm used to
long
trips!
choice_data_list: Since summer camp is going on, we ...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okey dokey! I'm gonna kick that race
right in the
heinie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide on the Queen Stakes
as our
warm-up for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"As for Yukino Bijin, she may not have
won today,
but she still gave a stellar
performance!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Wow.
You're incredible, Yuki...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen you look so fierce
b'fore... You're
so cool I can barely stand
it...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I gotta keep work'n hard if I wanna make
my
dream come true too!
